Title: General availability: EventHub action in Azure Monitor action groups

Body.Content:
The new EventHub action in Azure Monitor action groups enables you to gain control on the following scenarios:

  • Leverage a reliable, scalable queuing technology to ingest alerts
  • Achieve network isolation by subscribing to their EventHub using Private Links

Learn more.
